risks.title: Natural Catastrophe Risk
risks.score_rationale: AIG is exposed to potential losses from natural disasters such as hurricanes and earthquakes. These catastrophic events could have significant impact on insurance operations and financial results. Risks are partially mitigated through reinsurance and catastrophe modeling. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Exposure to natural disasters could result in substantial losses affecting operations and financial performance

risks.title: Terrorism Risk
risks.score_rationale: AIG is exposed to potential losses from terrorist attacks, particularly concentrated in New York City affecting property and workers compensation lines. Risks are mitigated by the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program Reauthorization Act (TRIPRA) and private reinsurance protections. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Terrorism exposure exists but is substantially mitigated through government programs and reinsurance

risks.title: Reinsurance Counterparty Risk
risks.score_rationale: AIG depends on reinsurance to manage insurance risks and capital adequacy. Potential failures of reinsurance counterparties could result in significant unmitigated losses, though this risk is managed through careful selection and monitoring. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Reliance on reinsurance partners creates exposure to counterparty credit risk

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: AIG is exposed to potential losses from credit defaults of counterparties and investment obligors. Credit quality deterioration could impact financial position. Risk is managed through credit policies and diversification. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Counterparty and investment credit risks are managed through established credit management processes

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: AIG faces potential losses from regulatory changes, particularly regarding capital requirements, reinsurance regulations, and insurance requirements. Changes in regulatory environment could impact operational costs and capital position. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Regulatory changes could impact operations but AIG maintains active regulatory compliance programs

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: AIG is exposed to reputational damage from service failures, claims handling issues, or other operational shortcomings. Reputational harm could impact customer relationships and business performance. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Reputation is managed through quality service delivery and customer-focused operations

company_description: American International Group, Inc. provides insurance products for commercial, institutional, and individual customers in North America and internationally. It operates through three segments: North America Commercial, International Commercial, and Global Personal. The company offers commercial and industrial property insurance, including business interruption and package insurance that cover exposure to made and natural disasters; general liability, environmental, commercial automobile liability, workers' compensation, excess casualty, and crisis management insurance products; risk-sharing and other customized structured programs for large corporate and multinational customers; professional liability insurance; and marine, energy-related property insurance products, aviation, political risk, trade credit, and trade finance products.
